args.title: Corvid blog: retail returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.corvid.example/2026/returns and its subscriber companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/returns/companion):

• Apparel return rates reached 24%.
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
• Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
